subject.title: [Bug]: Windows Scheduled Task gateway restart/health becomes inconsistent after ready

question: Should #63491 remain the canonical tracker until live Windows proof covers the full Scheduled Task restart/health failure, or should maintainers split and close it after the narrower fixes?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes and open sibling work, but automation cannot safely decide that the full Windows Scheduled Task user flow is fixed without maintainer acceptance of the proof boundary.

options.title: Keep Canonical Until Live Proof
options.body: Keep #63491 open and require one live Windows proof package covering relaunch, fallback, listener ownership, post-ready health, and stale-state recovery before closing.

options.title: Close After Narrow Proof
options.body: Close #63491 once maintainers decide #76245 plus #93299 or #90158 covers the remaining meaningful symptoms, even without one broad end-to-end proof.

options.title: Split Remaining Work
options.body: Move the remaining schtasks /Run and post-ready listener symptoms into narrower canonical issues, then close #63491 only after those links and proof expectations are explicit.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Until Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep #63491 open and require one live Windows proof package covering relaunch, fallback, listener ownership, post-ready health, and stale-state recovery before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee and authored the merged related policy-close restart-health repair.
